descriptionMarkdown:
All in one rail book with auto trains for mid- to early end game. Main features:
- 4 lane rail system for 1-4 trains
- Intersections with loops for better train navigations to/from stations
- Semi-detailed description of blueprints that are not self explanatory
- Smart trains using interrupts (with auto-refuel)
- Loading stations automatically set train limit from item count
- Unloading stations set stop priority from item count
- Unused trains go to depot
- Visual aid for station status and priority

Feel free to use any other station or intersection designs. Example book has some outdated stuff, ignore it, i was too lazy to update it.
